name: 92557 · Moreno Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 92557 (Moreno Valley) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92557 (Moreno Valley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
